body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> SoundForum(www.soundforum.co.kr) captured the attention of the visitors at CES 2008, presenting its high-end audio ‘TROPOS series’ developed by united Korean engineers.
Among the series, ‘Stravinsky’, a 3-way tall boy speaker consists of 5 units, attracted foreign dealers with its high-performance and economic efficiency.

According to the company, the Stravinsky adopted top quality parts; it employed 5-/10-inch Skaaning unit made in Denmark for low- and mid-band and Mundorf ribbon tweeter for high-band, to maximize impact, broadband and balance.
Through mini-interview with Su kyung Kim Director of SoundForum
The Stravinsky was the result of two years’ development work to test most of Skaaning drivers in the market, based on the company’s distribution experience of Skaaning drivers.
The Stravinsky aims to embrace analogue and digital sound in it. The speaker also can monitor parts’ working as well as recording condition.

Featuring advanced response time and broadband, it boasts stable large sound output and rich small sound. The company suggests that users should connect at least high quality player devices on the Stravinsky, even though the other systems are not high-end products.
Additional products presented during the CES 2008 include CD transport, DAC, free amp and power amp.
